selection.rule: best validation score of the kept checkpoint (arm_registry.select_seed), validation on the first 20 records of pub_SD2_vali_10x5+mix

arrays: row i = i-th record of desc/<R>/ in sorted file-name order
n_macros_note: n_macros counts every macro of the file except the n_macros_verdict combined-verdict macros (Pub<set>Rule...Verdict...)
superiority_verdict_rule: ahead: hierarchical 95% CI below zero and both Holm-adjusted one-sided p-values (seed-level t, bootstrap; H1 policy shorter) below 0.05; behind: CI above zero and both Holm-adjusted one-sided p-values for H1 policy longer (own Holm family over the eight combinations) below 0.05; not distinguishable otherwise
n_macros_dir_note: n_macros does not count the n_macros_dir direction macros of the pooled rows of sections 1, 2 and 7 (names ending in Dir after the verdict macros); the direction macros of section 8 are counted in n_macros with that section

references.reference: the schedule of every record of scripts/p91_public_cpsat_refs.py that p91 marks valid: CP-SAT, compact model, warm-started from the best of the four rules
references.difference: d = 100 (method - reference) / reference per instance; interval and direction only (a gap to a reference is not a comparison of two methods under test)
